mapper.select: SELECT INTERVIEW_NO , PROCESS_NO , INTERVIEW_DATE , INTERVIEW_LOCATION , INTERVIEW_TYPE , INTERVIEW_PASS_SCORE , INTERVIEW_DEL_DATE FROM INTERVIEW WHERE INTERVIEW_NO = #{interviewNo}

SELECT -- ApplicantRecord 컬럼 APRE.APPLICANT_RECORD_NO AS APRE_APPLICANT_RECORD_NO, APRE.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO AS APRE_RECRUITMENT_NO, APRE.APPLICANT_ID AS APRE_APPLICANT_ID, APRE.STEP_PASS_YN AS APRE_STEP_PASS_YN, APRE.STEP_APPLICATION_YN AS APRE_STEP_APPLICATION_YN, APRE.EVALUATION_START_TIME AS APRE_EVALUATION_START_TIME, APRE.APPLICANT_NAME AS APRE_APPLICANT_NAME, APRE.STEP_APPLICATION_YN AS APRE_STEP_APPLICATION_YN,
APP.USER_ID AS APP_USER_ID, REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO,
-- Interview 컬럼 INTR.INTERVIEW_NO AS INTR_INTERVIEW_NO, INTR.PROCESS_NO AS INTR_PROCESS_NO, INTR.INTERVIEW_DATE AS INTR_INTERVIEW_DATE, INTR.INTERVIEW_LOCATION AS INTR_INTERVIEW_LOCATION, INTR.INTERVIEW_TYPE AS INTR_INTERVIEW_TYPE,
-- RecruitmentNotice 컬럼 RENO.RECRUITMENT_NO AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_NO, RENO.JOB_CODE AS RENO_JOB_CODE, RENO.YEAR_CODE AS RENO_YEAR_CODE, RENO.REC_CONTENT AS RENO_REC_CONTENT, RENO.REC_POSITION_NUMBER AS RENO_REC_POSITION_NUMBER, RENO.RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL, RENO.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE, RENO.RECRUITMENT_RECEIPT_START AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_RECEIPT_START, RENO.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE, RENO.RECRUITMENT_TITLE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_TITLE
FROM APPLICANT_RECORD APRE LEFT OUTER JOIN APPLICANT APP ON APP.APPLICANT_ID = APRE.APPLICANT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN RECRUIT_PROCESS REPR ON APRE.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN INTERVIEW INTR ON REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = INTR.PROCESS_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE RENO ON RENO.RECRUITMENT_NO = REPR.RECRUITMENT_NO
WHERE APP.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY RENO.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE DESC -- ORDER BY INTR.INTERVIEW_DATE ASC

SELECT -- Interview 컬럼 INTR.INTERVIEW_NO AS INTR_INTERVIEW_NO, INTR.PROCESS_NO AS INTR_PROCESS_NO, INTR.INTERVIEW_DATE AS INTR_INTERVIEW_DATE, INTR.INTERVIEW_LOCATION AS INTR_INTERVIEW_LOCATION, INTR.INTERVIEW_TYPE AS INTR_INTERVIEW_TYPE, INTR.INTERVIEW_PASS_SCORE AS INTR_INTERVIEW_PASS_SCORE,
-- RecruitProcess 컬럼 REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO, REPR.RECRUITMENT_NO AS REPR_RECRUITMENT_NO, REPR.COMPANY_NAME AS REPR_COMPANY_NAME, REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP, REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_FINAL AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_FINAL, REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE,
-- RecruitmentNotice 컬럼 RENO.RECRUITMENT_NO AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_NO, RENO.USER_ID AS RENO_USER_ID, RENO.JOB_CODE AS RENO_JOB_CODE, RENO.YEAR_CODE AS RENO_YEAR_CODE, RENO.REC_CONTENT AS RENO_REC_CONTENT, RENO.PREFERENTIAL AS RENO_PREFERENTIAL, RENO.CITY_CODE AS RENO_CITY_CODE, RENO.DISTRICT_CODE AS RENO_DISTRICT_CODE, RENO.REC_POSITION_NUMBER AS RENO_REC_POSITION_NUMBER, RENO.RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL, RENO.RECRUITMENT_SALARY AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_SALARY, RENO.WELFARE AS RENO_WELFARE, RENO.RECRUITMENT_DESK AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_DESK, RENO.RECRUITMENT_IMG AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_IMG, RENO.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE, RENO.RECRUITMENT_RECEIPT_START AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_RECEIPT_START, RENO.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE, RENO.RECRUITMENT_TITLE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_TITLE, RENO.RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE,
-- ApplicantRecord 컬럼 APRE.APPLICANT_RECORD_NO AS APRE_APPLICANT_RECORD_NO, APRE.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO AS APRE_RECRUITMENT_NO, APRE.APPLICANT_ID AS APRE_APPLICANT_ID, APRE.STEP_PASS_YN AS APRE_STEP_PASS_YN, APRE.STEP_APPLICATION_YN AS APRE_STEP_APPLICATION_YN, APRE.INTERVIEW_URL AS APRE_INTERVIEW_URL, APRE.EVALUATION_START_TIME AS APRE_EVALUATION_START_TIME,
-- ApplicantVO 컬럼 APP.APPLICANT_ID AS APP_APPLICANT_ID, APP.RECRUITMENT_NO AS APP_RECRUITMENT_NO, APP.RESUME_NO AS APP_RESUME_NO, APP.RESUME_VIEW_YN AS APP_RESUME_VIEW_YN, APP.USER_ID AS APP_USER_ID, APP.APPLICANT_DEL_DATE AS APP_APPLICANT_DEL_DATE
FROM INTERVIEW INTR LEFT OUTER JOIN RECRUIT_PROCESS REPR ON INTR.PROCESS_NO = REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE RENO ON RENO.RECRUITMENT_NO = REPR.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN APPLICANT_RECORD APRE ON APRE.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN APPLICANT APP ON APRE.APPLICANT_ID = APP.APPLICANT_ID ORDER BY RENO.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE DESC

SELECT -- Interview 컬럼 INTR.INTERVIEW_NO AS INTR_INTERVIEW_NO, INTR.PROCESS_NO AS INTR_PROCESS_NO, INTR.INTERVIEW_DATE AS INTR_INTERVIEW_DATE, INTR.INTERVIEW_LOCATION AS INTR_INTERVIEW_LOCATION, INTR.INTERVIEW_TYPE AS INTR_INTERVIEW_TYPE, INTR.INTERVIEW_PASS_SCORE AS INTR_INTERVIEW_PASS_SCORE,
-- RecruitProcess 컬럼 REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO, REPR.RECRUITMENT_NO AS REPR_RECRUITMENT_NO, REPR.COMPANY_NAME AS REPR_COMPANY_NAME, REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP, REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_FINAL AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_FINAL, REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE,
-- RecruitmentNotice 컬럼 RENO.RECRUITMENT_NO AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_NO, RENO.USER_ID AS RENO_USER_ID, RENO.JOB_CODE AS RENO_JOB_CODE, RENO.YEAR_CODE AS RENO_YEAR_CODE, RENO.REC_CONTENT AS RENO_REC_CONTENT, RENO.PREFERENTIAL AS RENO_PREFERENTIAL, RENO.CITY_CODE AS RENO_CITY_CODE, RENO.DISTRICT_CODE AS RENO_DISTRICT_CODE, RENO.REC_POSITION_NUMBER AS RENO_REC_POSITION_NUMBER, RENO.RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL, RENO.RECRUITMENT_SALARY AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_SALARY, RENO.WELFARE AS RENO_WELFARE, RENO.RECRUITMENT_DESK AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_DESK, RENO.RECRUITMENT_IMG AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_IMG, RENO.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE, RENO.RECRUITMENT_RECEIPT_START AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_RECEIPT_START, RENO.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE, RENO.RECRUITMENT_TITLE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_TITLE, RENO.RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE,
-- ApplicantRecord 컬럼 APRE.APPLICANT_RECORD_NO AS APRE_APPLICANT_RECORD_NO, APRE.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO AS APRE_RECRUITMENT_NO, APRE.APPLICANT_ID AS APRE_APPLICANT_ID, APRE.STEP_PASS_YN AS APRE_STEP_PASS_YN, APRE.STEP_APPLICATION_YN AS APRE_STEP_APPLICATION_YN, APRE.INTERVIEW_URL AS APRE_INTERVIEW_URL, APRE.EVALUATION_START_TIME AS APRE_EVALUATION_START_TIME, APRE.APPLICANT_NAME AS APRE_APPLICANT_NAME,
-- ApplicantVO 컬럼 APP.APPLICANT_ID AS APP_APPLICANT_ID, APP.RECRUITMENT_NO AS APP_RECRUITMENT_NO, APP.RESUME_NO AS APP_RESUME_NO, APP.RESUME_VIEW_YN AS APP_RESUME_VIEW_YN, APP.USER_ID AS APP_USER_ID, APP.APPLICANT_DEL_DATE AS APP_APPLICANT_DEL_DATE,
-- VideoInterview 컬럼 VIV.INTERVIEW_NO AS VIV_INTERVIEW_NO, VIV.ROOM_TITLE AS VIV_ROOM_TITLE, VIV.MAX_JOIN_COUNT AS VIV_MAX_JOIN_COUNT, VIV.START_DATE AS VIV_START_DATE, VIV.END_DATE AS VIV_END_DATE, VIV.COMPANY_INTERVIEW_URL AS VIV_COMPANY_INTERVIEW_URL, VIV.VIDEO_INTERVIEW_DEL_DATE AS VIV_VIDEO_INTERVIEW_DEL_DATE,
-- InterviewQuestion 컬럼 INQ.INTERVIEW_QUESTION_NO AS INQ_INTERVIEW_QUESTION_NO, INQ.INTERVIEW_NO AS INQ_INTERVIEW_NO, INQ.INTERVIEW_QUESTION_CONTENT AS INQ_INTERVIEW_QUESTION_CONTENT, INQ.INTERVIEW_QUESTION_SCORE AS INQ_INTERVIEW_QUESTION_SCORE, INQ.INTERVIEW_QUESTION_DEL_DATE AS INQ_INTERVIEW_QUESTION_DEL_DATE
FROM INTERVIEW INTR LEFT OUTER JOIN RECRUIT_PROCESS REPR ON INTR.PROCESS_NO = REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE RENO ON RENO.RECRUITMENT_NO = REPR.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN APPLICANT_RECORD APRE ON APRE.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN APPLICANT APP ON APRE.APPLICANT_ID = APP.APPLICANT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN VIDEO_INTERVIEW VIV ON INTR.INTERVIEW_NO = VIV.INTERVIEW_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN INTERVIEW_QUESTION INQ ON INTR.INTERVIEW_NO = INQ.INTERVIEW_NO WHERE INTR.INTERVIEW_NO = #{interviewNo} ORDER BY APRE.APPLICANT_NAME ASC

SELECT COPN.COM_NAME AS COPN_COM_NAME , COPN.COM_EMAIL AS COPN_COM_EMAIL
, RENO.RECRUITMENT_TITLE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_TITLE , RENO.JOB_CODE AS RENO_JOB_CODE , RENO.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE , RENO.RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL
, REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP
, INTR.INTERVIEW_DATE AS INTR_INTERVIEW_DATE , INTR.INTERVIEW_LOCATION AS INTR_INTERVIEW_LOCATION , INTR.INTERVIEW_TYPE AS INTR_INTERVIEW_TYPE
, VIV.ROOM_TITLE AS VIV_ROOM_TITLE , VIV.MAX_JOIN_COUNT AS VIV_MAX_JOIN_COUNT , VIV.START_DATE AS VIV_START_DATE , VIV.END_DATE AS VIV_END_DATE FROM RECRUIT_PROCESS REPR LEFT OUTER JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE RENO ON RENO.RECRUITMENT_NO = REPR.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN COMPANY COPN ON COPN.USER_ID = RENO.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN INTERVIEW INTR ON INTR.PROCESS_NO = REPR.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN VIDEO_INTERVIEW VIV ON INTR.INTERVIEW_NO = VIV.INTERVIEW_NO WHERE INTR.INTERVIEW_NO = #{interviewNo}
